description_en: Retrieves the detailed configuration of a single DNS record, including the record value, priority, and back-to-origin authentication configuration (exclusive to CNAME records)
description_zh: 获取单条DNS解析记录的详细配置信息，包括记录值、优先级、回源鉴权配置（CNAME记录独有）等
name: GetRecord

parameters.help_en: The ID of the record. You can obtain this value by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850265.html
parameters.name: record_id
